# DVC Engineering Ltd

> DVC Engineering is a structural engineering consultancy based in London (EC2A 4NE), providing structural calculations, drawings and Building Regulations support for residential and commercial projects across London, Surrey, Sussex and the Midlands. Contact: enquiries@dvceng.com.

## Services

- [Loft Conversions](https://www.dvceng.com/services#loft-conversions): Structural design for loft, dormer and mansard conversions, including new floor joists, steel beams and roof alterations.
- [Rear Extensions](https://www.dvceng.com/services#rear-extensions): Calculations and drawings for single and two-storey rear extensions, covering beams, foundations and steelwork.
- [Side Extensions](https://www.dvceng.com/services#side-extensions): Structural design for side return and infill extensions.
- [Front Extensions & Porches](https://www.dvceng.com/services#front-extensions): Structural calculations for front extensions and porch additions.
- [New Builds](https://www.dvceng.com/services#new-builds): Full structural design for new residential dwellings, from foundations through to roof structure.
- [Basements & Underpinning](https://www.dvceng.com/services#basements): Structural design for basement excavations, lower ground floor conversions and underpinning works.
- [Garage Conversions](https://www.dvceng.com/services#garage-conversions): Structural checks and design for converting garages into habitable living space.
- [Structural Alterations](https://www.dvceng.com/services#structural-alterations): Load-bearing wall removal, steel beam (RSJ) installation and structural openings.
- [Outbuildings & Garden Rooms](https://www.dvceng.com/services#outbuildings): Structural design for garden rooms, summer houses and ancillary buildings.
- [Commercial Projects](https://www.dvceng.com/services#commercial): Structural surveys and calculations for change of use, mixed-use and commercial fit-out projects.

## Coverage

- [Areas We Cover](https://www.dvceng.com/areas-we-cover): All 32 London boroughs plus the City of London, Surrey, West Sussex, East Sussex & Brighton, Birmingham & the West Midlands, and the Milton Keynes / Northamptonshire / Luton corridor.

## Other

- [FAQ](https://www.dvceng.com/faq): Common questions about structural engineering, planning permission, Building Regulations and party wall agreements.
